items.title: How Backpack won CFTC approval to bring crypto perps onshore
items.summary:
CoinDesk’s The Policy Protocol hosts Rebecca Rettig and Renato Mariotti open on a fresh pair of SEC and CFTC commissioner nominations that arrived during the lame duck, then dig into two courtroom stories: a Southern District of New York judge’s acquittal of the Pereira Bueno brothers, and the Fourth Circuit’s ruling against prediction markets.

They’re joined by Mark Wetjen, President of Backpack US and a former Acting Chairman of the CFTC, fresh off Backpack’s approval for a US exchange, clearinghouse, and broker. Wetjen explains what Backpack means by a “global order book”: a single CFTC-overseen book, modeled on the CME, where KYC’d users worldwide eventually match on self-certified perps contracts.

They name Martha Stewart as the Person of the Week, on the back of a new Kalshi ad that uses a pecan-pie cooking demo to explain insider trading.
